status: DRAFT - not frozen; freeze = commit research/E5/protocol.json and record its sha256 before any statistic
question: At the close of session t, does any pre-registered combination of daily-bar features carry tradeable DIRECTION for sessions t+1..t+5 over the full evaluable universe, beyond matched controls, or is the lab's validated detection (9.3x / 5.4x / 4.6x matched-random lift for F1_ARA / G2_RET30) variance detection that cannot be traded? Secondary: does multi-session pre-move structure (volume creep, quiet range, volatility contraction, re-base) carry +30% information before the first big day, including the KOD-DET-v0 VOLUME_CREEP_PRICE_QUIET definition as a population base-rate row?
null_hypothesis: No daily-bar combination separates the coming +30% moves from the coming large down-moves; rankers trained on U and D select the same high-variance names; paired excess 5-session return of their flags over matched controls is <= 0 in every market and every discovery year.

binary_unranked: rebase = a session s0 in [t-40,t-6] with ret1>=0.30 (IDX: lock_up & tradeable), level(t)<=pre+0.5*(peak-pre), min level t-4..t >= pre
features_ranked.transform: per-session cross-sectional percentile rank among names present & tradeable at that session (mask by present BEFORE ranking so prefix-first causal check passes; NaN rank -> 0.5) plus squared rank; binaries enter as 0/1
features_ranked.definitions_source: research/E1/protocol.json weak_signals (E1-SIGNALS-v1), research/E2/protocol.json (E2-SIGNALS-v1), kod-machine/research/ZEALAND_PILOT_v1/03_card/price_facts.py; freqr/turn/logmcap excluded (not live-computable)
features_ranked.warmup: WARMUP = 60 literal: compute() returns NaN for the first 60 sessions of its view; every harness window starts 60 sessions before the period start so features are warm at period start (IDX discovery warm-up falls in TIER_2 2020-10..2021-01: used for features only, no trade, declared)

labels.U: max level(t+1..t+5) / level(t) >= 1.30 (E30, reference chain as e1.Study)
labels.D_IDX: rate-matched: threshold q fixed once on discovery such that P(min level ratio <= 1-q) = P(U) on discovery; IDX Arm B is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY because ARB was 7% flat through all of discovery (market.REGIMES) and changes on 2023-06-05 and 2023-09-04; IDX directional diagnostics are reported by ARB regime
labels.censoring: labels need t+5 inside the period (no label reads validation from discovery or the holdout from validation); crypto sessions t-5..t of a name with a unit reset (close/prev >= 20 or <= 1/20) have NaN labels; known 2020-2023 cases listed: COCOS 2021-01-23, DREP 2021-04-02, SUN 2021-06-18, LUNA 2022-05-31, VIDT 2022-11-09, BNX 2023-02-22, QUICK 2023-07-21, BTCST 2021-03-19 (to verify)

learner.type: L2 logistic regression, numpy IRLS, 25 iterations
learner.sampling: all positives + 10% seeded negative subsample weighted 10, seed 20261015
learner.threshold: discovery 99.5th percentile of each arm's score over evaluable ticker-days (top 0.5%, comparable to F1_ARA's 0.54% flag rate in 2023); fixed, never searched
learner.debounce: signal emitted only on the first session a name enters the top 0.5% after >= 5 sessions outside it (trailing, prefix-safe); detection statistics use debounced flags
learner.freeze: coefficients, thresholds, rank definitions committed as module-level literal tuples in moonshot_e5.py (rules/audit.py allows literals); rule hash covers them

descriptive_detectors_no_trading_unless_.A0_CREEP_QUIET: creep5v20 >= 1.5 AND quiet (exact KOD-DET-v0 VOLUME_CREEP_PRICE_QUIET logic, kod/detectors.py:72-86)
descriptive_detectors_no_trading_unless_.gate_for_a_trading_run: A1 gets ONE harness trading run under the market's plan only if its debounced detection lift vs volatility-matched controls >= 2.0 with one-sided p < 0.05 on discovery; otherwise reported only (base rate, precision, Wilson bounds, matched lift) as the KOD population row
descriptive_detectors_no_trading_unless_.univariate_table: matched-set AUC and lift for every ranked feature on discovery (E1 signal_stats pattern), the pre-screen proposal 1's refuter demanded

plans.rule: one plan per market, the recorded one; no plan search

IDX.tick_sensitivity: one tick per side (market.tick_size) added to fees, rule and controls alike

US.quarantine: none (repair_v3: quarantine is outcome-correlated); unit_schedule reported as sensitivity
US.stress: +1.5% per side reported (bound on uncorroborated 2020-22 tiers)

CRYPTO.entry: next open (= prior close in practice)
CRYPTO.fill_model_primary: A (as E2/E4 recorded runs, labelled ex-post)
sensitivities: A at max_participation 0.05 with doubled costs
entry at the close of t+1 via a CRYPTO_CLOSE profile variant (latency-pessimistic)
CRYPTO.costs: 0.1% fee + 0.1% tier per side = 0.2% per side (the recorded E2 config), not 0.3%

markets.IDX: TIER_1 panel-20261013T194245Z rebuilt from on-disk mirror bc0ac7712ce5 (fallback panel-20261007T225823Z + ca_registry-20261007T230210Z, declared); decisive market for Arm A (survivorship-complete)
markets.CRYPTO: decisive market for Arm B (no price limits, 190 delisted pairs present)
markets.US: survivor-only; all US results DIAGNOSTIC; a US-only pass is not decision-grade

periods.holdout: IDX 2024-01-02..2025-02-21 (backtest.HOLDOUT guard); US/CRYPTO 2024-01-01 on (GLOBAL_HOLDOUT guard from PR #7, plus e5.py asserts end <= validation end before building any RunConfig)
periods.declared_leak: 2023 is once-seen for the univariate siblings of E5 features (ara via E1, ret1 via E2, brk60 via US_BREAKOUT_v1; 2023 episode tables with ret5/ret20/volr/rngr/vol20/dd60 exist on disk under research/E1,E2 validation/). A 2023 pass is PROVISIONAL and licenses only a prospective paper policy, never the holdout.

matched_controls.trading_stage: controls v3 (new, additive): price_band, liquidity quintile, volatility QUINTILE, market_cap quintile (IDX mirror era), momentum tercile, drawdown tercile, listing_age; relaxed from the last feature to MIN_POOL 5; v2 reported for comparability; 200 draws per attempted signal, seed 20261007 (+1), same ExecConfig; same-session uniform baseline secondary
matched_controls.detection_stage: e1.Study pool extended to volatility quintile; US band uses the as-traded close (unit_factor attached), fixing the ERRATA.md wrong-band control defect; 200 draws per debounced flag, seed 20261008; doc share n/a
matched_controls.paired_statistic: per-signal excess = rule outcome minus the mean of its 200 matched controls (new additive trades.csv columns matched_mean_net_return / same_session_mean_net_return in backtest.run); session-cluster bootstrap over signal sessions, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261015, one-sided p; the harness's draw-distribution p is reported, not judged (anti-conservative when the rule's trades are more volatile than the controls')

stages.0_reproduce: re-run pinned runs on E5's panels from their recorded configs: IDX 20261009T050040Z_MOONSHOT_E1_D1_v1.1 (fill C), US 20261008T115656Z_MOONSHOT_E2_US_D1_v1 (fill B, as recorded incl. quarantine unit_schedule), CRYPTO 20261008T005732Z_MOONSHOT_E2_CRYPTO_D1_v1; REPRODUCED or DEVIATES on record (the 4th-decimal matched deviation from controls.py bcb89f0 is the only accepted cause)

1_information.what: fit, threshold, debounce; for every arm compute on discovery the fill-independent plan-window return on the reference chain (entry level at the plan's entry session: close t+1 IDX, open t+1 US/CRYPTO; exit level at the 5th close) for flags and matched controls alike, no fill/lot/lock/cost filter; AUC_U, AUC_D, E30 and D30 precision and lift, directional ratio with session-cluster bootstrap CI, pre-move split (ret1 < 10% vs >= 10%), univariate feature table, A0/A1 rows
1_information.gate_to_stage_2: paired gross excess mean > 0 with cluster-bootstrap one-sided p < alpha_adj AND > 0 in every discovery calendar year with >= 50 debounced flags; debounced flags >= 200
diagnostics: variance-detection check: Arm A D30 lift within the CI of its E30 lift

2_execution_discovery.what: backtest.run under the market plan for every arm that passed Stage 1 (and A1 if gated in); record every run in plans.csv
2_execution_discovery.admissible_iff: e3.admissibility verbatim (scored >= 200, avg net > 0, harness p < 0.05, avg net > 0 each discovery year with >= 50 scored) AND paired NET excess cluster-bootstrap p < 0.025 AND every pre-registered sensitivity keeps rule-minus-matched > 0 AND admissibility holds on the subset of trades with exit-session participation <= 10% (exit-capacity diagnostic from trades.csv.gz + panel)
2_execution_discovery.oracle_bound: in-flag break-even precision p* = (matched - E[net | flag, not E30]) / (E[net | flag, E30] - E[net | flag, not E30]) computed on the recorded F1_ARA / G2_RET30 runs' trade populations and on E5 flags; descriptive, never a run

stages.3_freeze: copy discovery/model.json coefficients and thresholds into moonshot_e5.py literals, set SELECTED per market, commit; validation refuses unless literals == model.json

4_validation_2023.runs: one write_run-recorded harness run per Stage-2-admissible arm plus its sensitivities
4_validation_2023.pass_iff: scored >= 100 (US >= 200), avg net > 0, paired net excess > 0 with cluster-bootstrap p < 0.025, harness p < 0.05, sensitivities agree in sign, detection Wilson lower bound > 2023 base rate
4_validation_2023.claim_level: PROVISIONAL (once-seen year): licenses a prospective paper policy only

consequences.stage_1_fails_in_both_primaries: daily-bar T-0 direction is not detectable by this learner over this feature list in the two markets where it can be measured; stop building tape-only detectors; next protocol = information timing (EDGAR 8-K acceptance, proposal 0) after the SEC reachability probe; KOD tape feed not stood up unless the A1 row's lift CI excludes 1
consequences.stage_1_passes_stage_2_or_validation_fai: information exists but is not executable under daily-bar plans with these costs/fills; next work = execution contract (limit-on-open, capacity, exit liquidity), not plan search; the prospective sidecar keeps scoring the frozen ranker
consequences.validation_passes: freeze MOONSHOT_E5_<MARKET>_D1; new POLICY_ID (PAPER-POLICY-v5) wires it through paper._detector; NO paper BUY until >= 100 prospective scored E5 decisions show paired excess > 0 (pre-registered); holdout stays sealed until then
consequences.A1_row_lift_ci_excludes_1: stand up a scan-only KOD feed (kod scan of the daily paper universes, no STRICT cases) under a new scanner id; otherwise VOLUME_CREEP_PRICE_QUIET is closed at KOD-DET-v0 thresholds

not_fixed_and_why: 2023 once-seen: no clean year exists in-repo; mitigated by pre-registration, Bonferroni, provisional claim level, prospective sidecar
US survivorship: no point-in-time universe on free data; US demoted to diagnostic
bounded learner: a null is 'not found by this learner'; the management consequence (stop tape-only detector building) is a decision, not a theorem; a second learner is a new protocol
IDX closing-auction spread: one-tick-per-side sensitivity only; a panel-v3 with mirror bid/offer depth is deferred
crypto legacy panel (2 future-informed row deletions incl. LUNA 2022-05-13): declared; a causal rebuild would make the precondition DEVIATE
daily bars only: no intraday path; crypto open is a zero-latency print, hence the close(t+1) sensitivity
search_size: 6 fits, 2 arms x 3 markets, 2 primaries, no threshold/lambda/feature search; stated in every output
claims: Historical research on assumed costs, daily-bar fills, survivor-only US universe; nothing here is prospective performance; no probability or trade is asserted; no real orders.
